playstyle: Eyes of the Nine brings six fighters: four mobile Tzeentch cultists and two fragile Chaos Daemons. The cultists move at 4 and can threaten at range, with Vortemis extending his melee reach to 2 hexes, while the Blue and Brimstone Horrors offer cheap board coverage at the cost of just 1–2 health. K'charik is the warband's hardest hitter but carries a high Bounty, demanding careful positioning. Victory comes from layering ranged pressure with focused melee, spending the disposable daemons to contest territory while the cultists dismanttle isolated foes.
